title: Chaos Flesh Muscle Simulation Tutorial (5.5)
description: Physics Engineer Yushan Han goes over the process of setting up a Chaos Flesh simulation, using a provided Emil muscle asset and detailing the new features and workflow for 5.5 using Dataflow.  The Chaos Flesh system provides high-quality, real-time simulation of deformable (soft) bodies in Unreal Engine, and this example will take the user through initial flesh setup through caching a final simulated result.
